svg.title: Address-structured cells
svg.desc: Three states of the same 16 by 16 board of 256 cells, 16 words each. From the last word's cell, arrows run to six likely next words. In the prime-zeta table the arrows are long and none ends in the 8 opened cells, giving 127 of 3,847 reachable targets. In the shuffled table they are shorter, giving 476. In the address-structured table the next words sit nearby and 1,351 of 3,847 are reachable. A bar chart compares five arms against a 500-row gate.
